02 A LITTLE ABOUT ME

Curiosity is
the constant.

Rohit.✳

◎ Based in Vadodara, Gujarat
Open to Ahmedabad, Pune, Bengaluru & remote.

I care about what happens after
the demo works.

Nearly three years of production software experience taught me to think beyond the feature: the backend behind it, the connection that drops, the release that has to work.

Today, I bring that same mindset to AI. I build RAG pipelines and LLM agents, then evaluate them — because an impressive answer is only useful when you can trust how you got there.

My path spans chemistry, cyber security, mobile development, and system architecture. The thread connecting all of it is a curiosity for how things work, and the patience to make them work better.
